tasting_notes: Carlsbad herbal bitter made since 1807 from a secret blend of ~20 herbs and spices around cinnamon and clove; sweetly spiced, gently bitter.
Sugar-free dry herbal aperitif launched 1966; drier and more sharply bitter than the Original.
Lower-strength citrus expression with fresh lemon over the herbal base.
Premium sweet liqueur first created 1910; rich, rounded and lightly bitter.
The 1807 recipe left unfiltered for a cloudier, rawer and more intense expression.
